correctness.rationale: The CRT residue is reduced because every auxiliary prime exceeds y and therefore cannot divide its assigned j. For any prime q in the residue class, each q+j has two distinct prescribed prime divisors, hence is not a prime power, while q is prime. Thus q is exactly the largest prime power not exceeding q+y and P(q+y)=y. PNT in arithmetic progressions gives the quantitative lower bound; Dirichlet alone gives infinitude. The finite checker is only regression evidence.
